passages.text:
Matt-
Thanks for pulling this together, I think we're on the home stretch. The GEC's program is the Digital Disinfo Index (DDI)
and I'm happy to pull folks together so we can integrate that work into this research.
I added a few comments below Josh's in the questions, mostly minor tweaks (e.g. including mal-information where we just
reference mis- and dis) and also language on 'building resilience'. In the IIR R&D meeting this morning, Mary Beth and
Brian intentionally flagged the NSM LOE on 'building resilience' and the research gap we have in that space. I think this is
mostly covered by question 3.
Also, I put some comments in about further clarification for question 5 on 'non-democratic actors'.
Thanks,
Diana

[opaque block] Google Vault- Information Ecosystem Theme Team Update
• What factors influence the information ecosystem related to disinformation, misinformation and malinformation?
• What factors influence the susceptibility to believing and sharing disinformation, misinformation and
malinformation?
• What factors influence the supply of disinformation, misinformation and malinformation?
• What enabling environmental factors influence both?
Can you please share any final suggested edits by Monday November 22nd COB. I will concurrently work on a draft
scope and invite you to a scoping discussion after Thanksgiving.
Many thanks again.
Best,
Matt
